item.description:
## What's fixed
- **The engine starts after a restart or login.** With Launch at Login on, Astronomical could come back from a restart with its menu-bar icon showing but the engine stopped, so chat, the terminal command and the local endpoint all reported that Astronomical was not running. The menu-bar agent now finds the engine however macOS starts it.
## Maintenance
- The acceptance tests compile again after the addition of decision models. - The README has a Download for Mac button and a quick start.
## Compatibility
- macOS 14.0 or later on Apple silicon. - Your installed models, chats and settings are preserved; the configuration format is unchanged.
This release is signed with a Developer ID, notarized by Apple, and delivered through the signed Sparkle update feed.
